ceilings._token_definition: input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens, summed across every fleet session in ~/.claude/projects/*Madhav*/ whose first message is at or after campaign_started_ts. Measured by bin/spend_meter.py into state/SPEND.jsonl. This is the raw four-class sum; it is dominated by cache_read (~97% of recent volume) and is therefore an AUDIT total, not a cost proxy and not a good runaway detector — see output_tokens_* for the tripwire that binds first in a loop.
ceilings._output_definition: output_tokens only, same sessions and window. Output is the best single proxy for work actually generated: cache_read scales with context size and session count, output scales with generation, so a fleet stuck in a loop trips this before the raw sum.
ceilings._cost_note: The ceiling that actually means money. NULL until state/PRICING.json carries current per-model, per-class rates — the four token classes differ by roughly an order of magnitude in price, so no single token count is a cost proxy. PRAHARI trips on whichever ceiling binds first; a null cost ceiling is simply not one of them yet.
